headlines.headline: Big Six Q2 Earnings Preview: NIM Expansion Seen Offsetting Higher Provisions — Bay Street
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Positive setup driver — if NIM + volume outweighs PCL creep, Q3 confirmed the preview (RBC NIM, CIBC NIM up) and drove ZEB to 52-week high; shows market will reward banks when NIM > PCL delta. Validates ZEB's carry thesis.

headlines.headline: Equifax Q2 Pulse: Mortgage Balances 90+ Days Past Due Rose to 0.30% in Ontario, led by Toronto
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Negative leading indicator — balance delinquency (size-weighted) rising faster than account delinquency means stress is in larger mortgages, exactly ZEB's Big Six exposure. Foreshadowed August CMHC breach (0.23% > 0.22% national) and explains why ZEB's provisions on performing loans stayed elevated even as headline earnings beat.

headlines.headline: ZEB Hits 52-Week High as Bank ETFs Draw $420M Inflows on Dividend Resilience
headlines.driver: For ZEB.TO: Positive flow driver — $420M inflows on 4-5% dividend resilience show ZEB is the defensive ballast vs Tech; price high reflects demand for oligopoly yield, not just earnings. Explains ZEB's YTD outperformance vs SPY when rates stay high.
